verses.pali: “Ye keci, bhikkhave, dhammā kusalā kusalabhāgiyā kusalapakkhikā, sabbe te manopubbaṅgamā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, intention shapes all phenomena whatsoever that are skillful, part of the skillful, on the side of the skillful.

verses.pali: Mano tesaṁ dhammānaṁ paṭhamaṁ uppajjati, anvadeva kusalā dhammā”ti.
verses.english: Intention is the first of those phenomena to arise, and skillful phenomena follow right behind.”
